name: Ofuna Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ofuna Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells drilling machines and related services in Taiwan, China, and Japan. The company provides laser drilling machines; precision spindles; molding machines and cleaning machines for printed circuit boards; processes, sells, and repairs and maintenance services for various printed circuit boards; and import and export trade of products and parts. It also offers overseas investment company equipment; sales and maintenance business; and printed circuit board equipment repairs. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.
